---
title: "Forecast performance"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source("R/setup.R")
forecasts <- arrow::read_parquet(data_file("forecasts.parquet"))
analysis <- arrow::read_parquet(data_file("analysis.parquet"))
leaderboard <- arrow::read_parquet(data_file("leaderboard.parquet"))

# Rows of `df` for one variable, without its excluded models.
for_variable <- function(df, v) {
  dplyr::filter(df, variable == v$variable, duration == v$duration,
                !model_id %in% excluded_models(v$variable))
}
summaries_link <- function(v) {
  path <- paste0(catalog_subdir(cfg, "summaries_path", "summaries"), "/", v$group, "/",
                 v$catalog_name, "/collection.json")
  paste0("Forecast summaries are available [here](", stac_browser_url(cfg, path), ").")
}
rows <- purrr::transpose(as.list(variables))
```

This page visualizes the forecasts and forecast performance for the focal target variables. Only forecasts from a few focal sites are shown. If you want to see your forecasts or scores, the links can be found in our [forecast catalog](%60r%20stac_browser_url(cfg,%20%22forecasts/collection.json%22)%60) and [scores catalog](%60r%20stac_browser_url(cfg,%20%22scores/collection.json%22)%60).

## Most recent forecasts {#sec-performance}

Forecasts submitted on `r if (nrow(forecasts) > 0) max(as.Date(forecasts$reference_datetime)) else "(none yet)"`.

```{r results = "asis"}
render_tabs(purrr::map(rows, function(v) {
  # Long-range forecasts are cut at 60 days so the plots stay readable.
  df <- for_variable(forecasts, v) |>
    dplyr::filter(datetime <= reference_datetime + lubridate::days(60))
  list(title = v$tab_title, text = summaries_link(v), widget = forecast_plots(df))
}))
```

## Forecast analysis

Below are forecasts submitted about 30 days ago (a year ago for weekly variables), with the observations used to evaluate them. Mouse over to see the model id, and scroll to zoom. Information on how to access the scores can be found in our [catalog](%60r%20stac_browser_url(cfg,%20%22scores/collection.json%22)%60).

```{r results = "asis"}
render_tabs(purrr::map(rows, function(v) {
  list(title = v$tab_title, widget = forecast_plots(for_variable(analysis, v)))
}))
```

## Aggregated scores

Average skill scores of each model across all sites, by model, by reference date and by forecast horizon (in days, up to `r settings$leaderboard_max_horizon`).

Scores are averaged across all submissions made in the last 30 days for daily and sub-daily variables, and in the past year for weekly variables.

Learn about the Continuous Ranked Probability Score [here](https://projects.ecoforecast.org/neon4cast-docs/Evaluation.html).

```{r results = "asis"}
render_tabs(purrr::map(rows, function(v) {
  list(title = v$tab_title, widget = leaderboard_plots(for_variable(leaderboard, v)))
}))
```
